questions.title: Keyword for a function
questions.question: Which keyword starts a function definition in Python?
questions.explanation: `def` starts a function; `lambda` makes a small anonymous one.

questions.title: Merge sort complexity
questions.question: What is the time complexity of merge sort?
questions.explanation: It halves the list log n times and merges n items at each level.
